meta.title: Douyin wallpaper
meta.description: Paste a Douyin link and the minimal DSH interface becomes its playback surface: the clip fills the window and the interface floats above it as frosted glass. Open the panel from the ▶ icon beside Settings at the sidebar foot, paste the whole text that Douyin's Share → Copy link produces, and press Enter — the video is resolved, downloaded locally and painted behind the shell; an image post is fetched as a whole album, drifting slowly as a single picture and crossfading every 7 seconds when it holds several. The panel adjusts glass opacity, blur, dimming, brightness, scale, mute and looping; changes apply instantly and persist on this machine (state.json), so a reload or a new window restores the same wallpaper, and a first run starts with the clip at its plainest: brightness at the ceiling, blur and dimming at zero. Douyin video, image and multi-video carousel pages (douyin.com / iesdouyin.com) are accepted, plus an absolute local file path; collections, live streams and private posts are not. Resolution prefers the local douyin_lapian.py (playwright driving the system Edge headless, which does not trip the captcha) and falls back to a third-party parser when no script is configured (api.xingzhige.com by default, which therefore receives the link — set DSH_DWP_PARSE_API to use your own); image posts try the optional DSH_DWP_PARSE_API_ALBUM first, then the markup Douyin still renders for crawlers. Media stays local and is never uploaded; the plugin registers no Tool, adds no prompt text and writes nothing to the session, so it costs no model tokens. Disabling the plugin restores the stock interface at once.
